summary: Iteration 14: Validated 'Replay Mode' (storm major events). Backend GET /api/replay/events: returns {events:[], source_window_h:24} on calm conditions (200 OK). Burst detection algorithm verified end-to-end via in-process ASGI tests with injected synthetic strikes — correctly identifies 2 bursts (12+8 strikes) while ignoring 1 isolated strike between them, excludes bursts <5min duration and bursts with <5 strikes. Event payload shape complete: id='ev-{ts}', start_ts/end_ts (int), duration_min (float), strike_count, peak_count_10min, center_lat/center_lon (4-decimal rounded), max_distance_km. Sort order verified by (-peak_count_10min, -strike_count, -start_ts). Query params (lat/lon/radius_km/min_strikes/gap_min) accepted, invalid types return 422. Frontend /replay page: renders with 4 NavTabs (Direct/Vigilance/Replay/Historique), 'Comment ça marche' panel + Résumé counter, empty state visible when 0 events. Dashboard bootstrap: ?replay=<start>:<end> sets cursorTs=start, playing=true, displays purple replay-banner with 'Mode replay · lecture en cours' + formatted dates, URL cleaned of param (replace state). Exit button removes banner & replay state. CTA replay-cta correctly absent when 0 events available. Live mode regression intact (no banner, no CTA when no events). 7/7 backend pytest pass, frontend e2e pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py replay_events: bursts <5 min duration are silently dropped AFTER min_strikes check — small wasted work but fine. No business issue.
ReplayPage.jsx playEvent pre-rolls 5 min before start_ts but caps at now-24h; does NOT cap at end_ts — fine since pre < start <= end always.

Dashboard bootstrap useEffect deps array intentionally empty (eslint-disable) so ?replay= is consumed once at mount — correct pattern. Re-mount needed for repeat replays (works since ReplayPage uses navigate which triggers re-render).

Auto-stop logic (cursorTs >= replay.end_ts → setPlaying(false)) only triggers if Timeline actually ticks cursor forward in replay mode. Visually verified bootstrap path; auto-stop edge depends on Timeline.jsx interval which is out of scope of this iter (already validated in iter 13).
replayEventsCount is fetched every 5min via setInterval; no debounce/visibility check — minor efficiency point, not a bug.

Inconsistency in StrikeStore.recent until_ts check (s.ts > until_ts → exclude) means timestamps EQUAL to until_ts are KEPT, slight drift from docstring 'exclusive upper'. Pre-existing from iter 13, not introduced here.
